IncidentBot: PAGER: high error rate on /v1/generate (latency spikes, 5xx) -- paging oncall @alex (oncall) and @sara.

Alex (oncall): saw the page, joining. I'm on my phone, give me a minute. Any visible customer impact?

Sara: brief look -> dashboard shows 5xx jump ~1769901100 -> 1769901200, affected region: us-west-2. Rate limiter errors + runtime OOMs in some pods.

Alex (oncall): ok muted alerts, putting incident call on :phone: if needed. Devon, can you grab logs for failed pods in us-west-2?

Devon: grabbing logs now, tailing inference runtime logs. Pasting snippets below.

Devon: ```
2026-03-25T12:00:22Z runtime[svc-gg1] ERROR kvcache: failed to allocate shard 3: cuda out of memory
2026-03-25T12:00:23Z runtime[svc-gg1] WARN request: fallback to cpu-quantized model variant
2026-03-25T12:00:24Z proxy[router] ERROR downstream: write EPIPE
```

Alex (oncall): interesting — OOMs then router EPIPEs. Could be a capacity spike + router not closing fast. Maria, any recent deploys to us-west-2?

Maria: no customer-facing deploys in last 6 hours. There was an infra config change to autoscaler earlier today at 09:12PT by infra-team but that was global. I can check infra jobs.

Chris: adding live mitigation idea: scale down batching window to reduce per-request memory, and enable immediate fallbacks to smaller model variant. Can we do that safely?

Alex (oncall): do quick canary change: reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024 for us-west-2 runtime-pool and toggle fallback prewarm. Who can run the patch?

Sara: I can run the config change. Preparing command.

Sara: ```bash
# updating runtime config for pool us-west-2-primary
redwood-cli runtime update --pool us-west-2-primary --set max_batch_tokens=1024 --set fallback_variant=small-quant
```

Sara: applying now. Rolling config.

OpsBot: CONFIG-ROLL STARTED runtime/us-west-2-primary max_batch_tokens->1024 fallback_variant->small-quant (triggered by sara)

Alex (oncall): keep monitoring logs and SLOs. I'll draft a short status page. We need: what happened, impact, mitigation, ETA for fix. Sara, update here when config roll completes.

Devon: after change, observing decreased OOMs but increased tail latency for some requests using small-quant. Still seeing EPIPEs from router for ~10% of requests.

Sara: OpsBot reports roll complete on 1769901458.

OpsBot: CONFIG-ROLL SUCCESS runtime/us-west-2-primary 1769901458

Alex (oncall): good. Drafting status page now — please critique. Posting below.

Alex (oncall): STATUS PAGE DRAFT: 
- Incident start: ~2026-03-25T12:00:00Z
- Symptoms: increased 5xx errors and latency on /v1/generate for customers in us-west-2; some requests returned 5xx or failed mid-stream.
- Impact: ~12% of requests in us-west-2 observed failures or degraded latency from 12:00–12:18 UTC. Affected customers: multiple PLG tenants on shared pool; no data loss reported.
- Mitigation: reduced batch token window and enabled fallback to small-quant model variant; config roll completed at 12:10 UTC; observed reduction in OOMs.
- Next steps: continue monitoring for 2 hours, roll model variant changes to more robust quant profile if instability persists, follow-up RCA.

Chris: looks solid. Suggest adding "customers may see truncated streaming responses" and a link to support runbook.

Alex (oncall): adding note and linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-ooms

Maria: timeline notes to add (from infra audit):
- 09:12 UTC infra autoscaler policy change (no direct correlation yet)
- 11:50 UTC small spike in throughput from customer X (burst test)
- 12:00 UTC first OOMs recorded
- 12:04 UTC router errors start increasing
- 12:07 UTC paging triggered
- 12:08 UTC first mitigation (batch token reduction) planned
- 12:10 UTC config roll complete
- 12:15 UTC error rate down to baseline but some residual tail errors

Devon: adding hypothesis list inline:
1) sudden traffic spike (customer-side load test) + autoscaler slow to add nodes -> OOMs in GPU pool -> service degradation.
2) memory leak/regression in recent runtime subtle under-high-concurrency. (but no code deploy)
3) network flapping between router and runtime causing EPIPE cascades.

Sara: quick checks: no code deploys, no new runtime images. Autoscaler metrics show scale-up requested at 12:02 but new nodes not provisioned until 12:12 (cloud API rate-limited). That supports hypothesis (1).

Alex (oncall): capture that as primary hypothesis for RCA: autoscaler provisioning lag during burst => short window of OOMs + router failures. We'll keep hypotheses 2 and 3 as secondary.

Chris: for in-incident notes, I'm collecting per-request traces. Posting small sample for a failed request: 
```
trace_id=abc123 start=2026-03-25T12:01:05Z
router->runtime latency 120ms
runtime kv_alloc attempt: 2 -> oom
runtime switched variant -> queued -> dropped (write EPIPE)
```

Alex (oncall): thanks. For stakeholder comms: I'll message support-leads and account-ops with the draft status page and impact notes. Who will own post-incident RCA? prefer SRE + runtime team.

Maria: runtime team + infra SRE from my side. Assigning Devon and Chris to timeline + logs, Sara to comms and status page updates. I'll create RCA doc after incident stabilized.

Alex (oncall): handoff plan: I'm going offline at 12:35 for a short break. Maria will take lead until 13:30, then runtime lead will pick up. Please add any outstanding actions here.

Sara: posting final status page update now to status.redwood.com (short message) and pinging CSMs for high-usage tenants.

Sara: STATUS PUBLISH: "We experienced elevated error rates and latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2 between 12:00–12:15 UTC. Mitigations applied; monitoring shows recovery. Our team is investigating root cause and will provide a detailed RCA."

Devon: saving collected logs and traces to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1769901234/logs.tar.gz

Chris: created timeline doc draft: https://docs.internal/incidents/1769901234-timeline (will add more trace entries).

Alex (oncall): thanks team — good mitigation and comms. Leaving the thread in hands of Maria and runtime. Please escalate if error rate creeps back above 2x baseline.

Maria: acknowledged. I'll run post-mortem template once we've collected all artifacts. Expected RCA draft ETA EOD.
